dialog:
Uninstall RB Stems Plus? / rekordbox goes back to exactly how it was. Your music and rekordbox library aren't touched.

RB Stems Plus will be deleted, including the stems it saved. {Uninstall*, Cancel}
Install Demucs v4? / Replaces rekordbox's stems model with Demucs v4. rekordbox's own model is kept, so it can be put back. {Install*, Cancel}
